official_sources.title: OGC Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF Standard
official_sources.finding: COG formalizes tiled GeoTIFF/BigTIFF organization, reduced-resolution subfiles and HTTP byte-range serving; full-resolution georeference remains GeoTIFF-based.
official_sources.limitation: COG conformance optimizes access but does not itself prove that the remote bytes stayed unchanged between range requests.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: OGC GeoTIFF Standard 1.1
official_sources.finding: GeoTIFF distinguishes PixelIsArea from PixelIsPoint and defines raster-to-model mapping through ModelTiepointTag with ModelPixelScaleTag or ModelTransformationTag; vertical CRS and units can be encoded with the VerticalGeoKey family.
official_sources.limitation: GeoTIFF metadata must be read from the exact target asset; the standard does not validate a parcel boundary or source survey.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL COG driver and validator
official_sources.finding: GDAL COG creation may generate overviews and preprocessing; COG validity can be checked, and update-mode edits can break optimized layout.
official_sources.limitation: A valid COG can still contain the wrong survey, wrong resolution or wrong values for the target parcel.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL Virtual File Systems /vsicurl
official_sources.finding: /vsicurl/ performs piece-wise HTTP range access and has explicit cache/retry behavior; remote exact reads therefore require a stable representation and a recorded retry/cache policy.
official_sources.limitation: Range-capable access improves efficiency but remote representation stability must be checked separately.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: RFC 9110 HTTP Semantics
official_sources.finding: ETag and Last-Modified are HTTP representation validators; strong validators support exact range consistency, and If-Range can prevent mixing byte ranges from a changed representation.
official_sources.limitation: Not every server provides a strong ETag; weak or absent validators require a full immutable download/hash path before terminal use.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: STAC Specification
official_sources.finding: A STAC Item is a GeoJSON feature representing an atomic data-and-metadata unit and links its assets through explicit asset hrefs and relationships, supporting a reproducible asset manifest.
official_sources.limitation: Core STAC metadata identifies assets but does not by itself guarantee byte immutability or elevation accuracy.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL raster info
official_sources.finding: gdal raster info can report CRS, resolution, band unit, NoData/mask and checksums; approximate statistics may use overviews or a subset and are unsuitable for exact extrema.
official_sources.limitation: GDAL pixel checksum is useful for reproducibility checks but is not a cryptographic asset digest.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdalbuildvrt
official_sources.finding: VRT mosaics can depend on input order for overlap priority and may skip incompatible files unless strict mode is used; resolution and NoData policy are configurable.
official_sources.limitation: A VRT is derived metadata; exact terminal results require immutable source rasters and deterministic input ordering.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdal raster mosaic
official_sources.finding: Raster mosaics expose explicit same/highest/lowest/average/common resolution policy, target-aligned pixels, input/output NoData and overlap pixel functions.
official_sources.limitation: Any non-native resolution or overlap function can alter extrema and must be prohibited or separately justified for terminal values.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL Geometry Validity
official_sources.finding: Invalid geometries can produce incorrect spatial intersection results; validity must be checked before parcel/raster spatial algorithms, and geometry validity alone does not detect inter-feature gaps or overlaps.
official_sources.limitation: Validity is necessary but not sufficient to prove that the parcel is the correct legal/canonical geometry.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdal vector check-coverage
official_sources.finding: Coverage validity requires no polygon overlaps, matching nodes on shared edges and controlled gaps; individual polygon validity is a separate prerequisite.
official_sources.limitation: Coverage checks apply only when a polygon collection/coverage is available; the current slot still lacks the bound canonical target boundary.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdal vector make-valid
official_sources.finding: MakeValid can change geometry structure or dimensional components and offers linework/structure methods; any repair must be treated as a derived geometry and compared against the original rather than silently replacing it.
official_sources.limitation: Automatic repair can alter topology or dimensionality; no repaired geometry may become canonical without explicit provenance and equivalence checks.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL GTiff driver
official_sources.finding: GeoTIFF masks can be internal or external .msk sidecars and overview masks have distinct storage behavior, so the complete file set and mask provenance must be frozen with the raster.
official_sources.limitation: Hashing only the .tif while omitting an external .msk/.ovr can make later pixel-validity replay non-equivalent.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL RFC 33 PixelIsPoint interpretation
official_sources.finding: PixelIsPoint handling involves a half-pixel georeferencing interpretation and legacy GDAL compatibility behavior; terminal raster support geometry must record raster type and relevant implementation/version semantics.
official_sources.limitation: Legacy files and configuration can shift interpreted support by half a pixel; runtime version/config must be captured.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply
